summary: Entra ID is the security perimeter; Conditional Access, MFA, and RBAC/PIM enforce zero-trust, least-privilege access.
highYield: Conditional Access policies: sign-in risk, MFA, device compliance, and location/conditions ('IF condition THEN grant/block').
Microsoft Entra ID Protection: user risk (account likely compromised) vs sign-in risk (session suspicious).
Privileged Identity Management (PIM): just-in-time activation, approvals, and audit; Entitlement Management and access reviews.
Authentication methods: MFA (FIDO2, Microsoft Authenticator, phone), passwordless, and self-service password reset (SSPR).
Hybrid identity: Microsoft Entra Connect, PHS/PTA/federation, and Microsoft Defender for Identity for on-prem detection.
memoryAids: User risk = account compromised; Sign-in risk = session suspicious.

summary: Protect data at rest, in use, and in transit with encryption, identity-based access, and network segmentation.
highYield: Storage auth: shared key vs SAS vs Microsoft Entra ID; SSE encryption at rest, customer-managed keys, storage firewall, private endpoints.
Database protection: TDE (at rest), Always Encrypted (columns/in-use), dynamic data masking, SQL firewall, private endpoints.
Azure Key Vault: secrets/keys/certs, RBAC vs access policies, soft-delete + purge protection, key rotation.
Network security: NSG/ASG, Azure Firewall, DDoS Protection, Web Application Firewall (WAF) on App Gateway/Front Door.
Private Endpoint (private IP in VNet) vs Service Endpoint (public IP over private backbone).
memoryAids: TDE = at rest; Always Encrypted = in use; TLS = in transit.
SAS = scoped, key = full, Entra ID = identity-based.
Key Vault + soft-delete protects against accidental and malicious delete.

summary: Harden VMs, containers, and app platforms with Defender protection, patching, and identity-based (secret-free) access.
highYield: Microsoft Defender for Cloud: Defender for Servers (EDR), Defender for Containers (registry + runtime), Defender for App Service; just-in-time VM access.
Encryption: Azure Disk Encryption (BitLocker/DM-Crypt) vs encryption at host; Azure Update Manager for patch compliance.
Container security: ACR scanning, Defender for Containers, Kubernetes RBAC, network policies, image signing.
Managed Identity for apps/containers (no secrets in code) and App Service Easy Auth.
VM hardening: NSGs, Azure Bastion (no public RDP/SSH), Antimalware, secure boot.
memoryAids: JIT VM access = open RDP/SSH only when needed.
Managed Identity = no secrets in code.
Defender for Servers = VM EDR; Defender for Containers = K8s + registry.

summary: Continuously assess and improve security posture with Defender for Cloud Secure Score, Sentinel SIEM/SOAR, and compliance controls.
highYield: Microsoft Defender for Cloud: Secure Score, security recommendations, regulatory compliance (NIST, CIS, ISO), CSPM vs CWPP.
Microsoft Sentinel: SIEM/SOAR with data connectors, analytics rules, incidents, and Logic Apps playbooks.
Microsoft Defender XDR integrates Endpoint, Identity, Office 365, and Cloud Apps signals.
Microsoft Purview: sensitivity labels, information protection, and DLP.
Attack path analysis and exposure management for proactive risk reduction.
memoryAids: Secure Score = how secure (higher = better); recommendations = how to fix.
